description:
At PicnicAI, we build intelligence to accelerate human health. We bring AI into the real-world complexity of care delivery and clinical research, where it gets decided whether patients get the care and treatments they need. We do this work in direct partnership with patients. PicnicAI powers two product lines: PicnicResearch for sponsors and research organizations, and PicnicHealth for patients and their caregivers.

PicnicResearch makes clinical research faster, more cost-effective, and more reliable to unlock an abundance of new treatments for patients. Patients enroll remotely, and we retrieve complete medical records across all treating providers, with no site network required. By combining scientific expertise, patient-connected study design, and AI-enhanced infrastructure, we help sponsors answer their research questions and stay connected with patients over time.

15 of the top 20 biopharma companies rely on PicnicResearch to generate clinical evidence. Our work spans 40+ diseases in 10+ therapeutic areas and has produced 75+ publications. Founded in 2014, we’ve raised more than $100M from investors including Amplify Partners, Felicis Ventures, B Capital Group, and Y Combinator. We’re a team of doctors, patients, data specialists, engineers, and builders working to change how clinical research gets done.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Project Manager, Study Success (SPM), you’ll help shape how PicnicResearch works in practice. You’ll lead the delivery of complex real-world and observational studies for pharma and biotech partners, blending deep knowledge of clinical research with operational excellence. You’ll also help advance how those studies get done. You’ll use AI in your daily work, test new approaches, and help convert the most effective ones into standard practices across the team.

In this highly cross-functional role, you’ll drive the planning, implementation, and execution of studies, making sure we deliver on time, with quality, and with a focus on creating value for our partners. You’ll collaborate closely with epidemiologists, biostatisticians, patient recruitment, operations, and product, and work directly with sponsors to create seamless study experiences for the patients and partners we serve.

This role reports to the Head of Delivery Success.

What you’ll do:

  • Provide functional leadership and drive end-to-end study execution with a focus on operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and business growth, delivering projects on time, within scope, and aligned with strategic outcomes.
  • Drive cross-functional execution by anticipating needs and risks, navigating trade-offs, and bridging internal expertise with sponsor priorities to keep studies moving forward.
  • Use AI across your study work, from planning and status reporting to risk tracking and financial forecasting, and pilot new methods, workflows, and tools, helping put what works into practice across our studies.
  • Implement clear and scalable project governance practices that drive visibility into progress, risks, and performance across study workstreams.
  • Act as the financial steward of your studies: manage forecasting, reporting, and scope changes in close partnership with internal teams and external sponsors.
  • Own the flow of study-critical information, so stakeholders stay aligned, risks surface early, and decisions are made with full context across functions and partners.
  • Ensure successful and timely execution of study designs, patient recruitment, data collection, and analytics, partnering with your study’s Epidemiologist and specialist teams (biostatistics, data management, recruitment, patient engagement, compliance and product).
  • Monitor project progress, develop solutions to mitigate risks, and implement corrective actions as needed to ensure a successful study outcome.
  • Where needed, manage external vendor workstreams for your studies.
  • Work internally to inform and influence how we scale our tech-forward platform to streamline delivery.

What we’re looking for:

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a life science area or public health, along with 5 years working in the clinical trials/research industry, with at least 2 years leading and managing multiple concurrent full-service research studies.
  • Experience working with observational or low-interventional research studies, including both site-based and decentralized studies.
  • Experience leading complex real-world or clinical research studies using structured project management methodologies (PMP or equivalent).
  • Direct experience with medical records and claims data in the biopharmaceutical or RWD industry.
  • Strong history of driving outcomes across multidisciplinary teams, including scientific, technology, patient engagement, and commercial stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills that motivate and influence other teams to action.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to quality.
  • Well-versed in relevant research regulations (e.g., ICH-GCP, HIPAA), with the judgment to apply them in evolving, tech-forward models.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools in your project management work, and proven ability to adapt quickly to new technology and workflows.

How you work:

  • You’re excited to use AI to accelerate clinical research. You want to work somewhere that expects it, and you’re always looking for the next way it can make studies better.
  • You experiment. You try new methods and tools, measure what works, and act on it.
  • You adapt. Our processes evolve as we find better ways to work, and you help lead that.
  • You work independently. You make sound decisions in ambiguous situations, take ownership of your work, and know when to bring others in.
  • You’re practical. You anticipate blockers, manage ambiguity, and keep studies on track without lowering the bar on quality.

We expect all team members to be amazing in their roles and, ultimately, to move the PicnicResearch mission forward.

The other perks & benefits you get when you work at PicnicAI

We pay competitive salaries. Everyone on the team is an owner: all full time employees get competitive equity.

Target Base Salary Range: $130K - $160K

The base salary PicnicAI offers may vary depending upon the scope, complexity, and autonomy of the position and on the candidate’s job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

We’re a remote first company, with teammates spread across the US. We support in-person gatherings, including co-working spaces and multi-day onsites, to build connections and move forward strategic initiatives. Travel varies by role.

You also get:

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents
  • Family friendly environment
  • Flexible time off
  • Picnic Friday holidays: extended long weekends on select Fridays throughout the year
  • 401k plan
  • Free PicnicHealth account
  • Equipment and internet funds for home office set up
  • Quarterly wellness stipend

PicnicAI is committed to promoting an inclusive work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We value a diverse and balanced team where everyone can belong.
